title: Noise
text: Model noise using current or voltage noise source in RF systems, {Impulse response duration} sets Impul; {Source type} sets the noise type Ideal, {Noise distribution}, {Noise power spectral density} sets the single-sided noise power spectral, {Frequencies}, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration} sets the estimate impulse response duration and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source type
params.values: Noise type Ideal voltage (default) | Ideal current

params.name: Noise distribution
params.values: Noise distribution type White (default) | Piece-wise linear | Colored

params.name: Noise power spectral density
params.values: Single-sided noise power spectral distribution 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Frequencies
params.values: Frequencies for piece-wise linear noise distribution 0 Hz (default) | vector of non-negative frequencies | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Automatically estimate impulse response duration
params.values: Estimate impulse response duration on (default) | off

params.name: Impulse response duration
params.values: Impulse response duration to simulate colored noise 1e-10 s (default) | scalar | s | ms | us | ns

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
